_comment: Drive-shaped permissions manifest: each entry mirrors a Google Drive file's permission export (owner + explicit viewers). Ingestion writes these as OpenFGA document owner/viewer tuples BEFORE the file's chunks become queryable. viewers entry '*' means public (user:*). In v1 this manifest is replaced by a live pull of real Drive file permissions via the broker's Google grant; the FGA-as-end-user retrieval filter is unchanged.

documents.note: Adversarial protected doc — the top embedding hit for the acquisition-timeline query; alice (viewer) may retrieve it, bob may not.
Owner-only — no explicit viewers; only bob (as owner) sees it.
Per-user shared — alice and bob, not carol-only.
